title: Session cookies lack HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite flags
description: PHPSESSID, security, and dvwaSession cookies are set without HttpOnly (accessible to JavaScript), Secure, or SameSite attributes. An XSS vulnerability could be used to steal the session cookie.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=oh7b9qbtd9c0dueninuaf8i9h1; path=/ Set-Cookie: security=low
